ticker_directory.description: Master mapping of stock ticker symbols to 10-digit Central Index Keys (CIKs) and legal entity names.

company_submissions.description: Chronological history of all regulatory filings submitted by the entity, including accession numbers, filing dates, and report periods.

filing_archives.description: Individual filing accession directory containing pre-isolated XBRL footnote reports (e.g. R8.htm) and full-text filings.

compliance_and_governance.user_agent_requirement: Sample: User-Agent: SampleCompany Analyst contact@sample.com (mandatory email format)
compliance_and_governance.caching_policy: Filing artifacts are immutable once filed; historical footnote HTML may be permanently cached.
